idea.title: Universal Memory Protocol – a shared format for agent memory

plan.tagline: A universal memory format for AI agents that works offline and across tools.
plan.problem: AI agents and automation tools lack a standardized way to share memory, causing fragmented workflows and duplicated effort.
plan.solution: A CLI tool that stores agent memory in a shared SQLite format, enabling seamless data exchange between scripts, agents, and services without external APIs.
plan.target_market: Indie hackers and small dev teams building agentic workflows who need lightweight, offline-first memory sharing.
plan.demo_script: Run `memprotocol --demo` to see a simulated agent workflow with 3 stored memories, a JSON export, and a summary report—all offline.
plan.phuket_angle: Thai tourism agencies could use it to sync client preferences (e.g., villa bookings, tour interests) across chatbots, CRM scripts, and email tools without cloud dependency.
